reason: Gathering notifications are now actually deliverable. Before DEC-139, GatheringService._link_reminder wrote platform="event" into the linked reminder row — a value that is not a wired adapter key, so the fire path raised KeyError and the notify died as a heartbeat error, invisible to the group. The linked reminder now records the real delivery platform (from the tool layer's room) and carries kind="gathering" with a denormalized payload, dispatching through the new kind→factory registry. Also: the gathering/RSVP module renamed Event→Gathering internally (tool names and /app/v1/events routes unchanged).
details: Gathering reminders fire into the room where the gathering was set (previously dead on arrival).
Reminder rows gain kind/payload columns (additive, defaulted; existing rows byte-identical).
Heartbeat groups due rows by kind, so a plain reminder + gathering notify due together are two turns.
